name: Mars Gardens
summary: Fifty years after landing on Mars, the colony thrives in Mars Gardens, a vibrant public plaza and fully operational farm nestled within a cutting-edge bio-dome. This innovative space allows colonists to cultivate oversized crops that sustain the community, as well as practice their putting skills in the unique low-gravity environment. Graceful slopes and craters will challenge your abilities as you wind through the lush green gardens, safe from the harsh surface conditions of the red planet.
